stories.message: Home page (/) does show every Pizzas item above every Drinks item (criterion 1 holds). But the relative order of the other categories was not preserved: GET /preview/MenuApi returns categories in alphabetical order [Drinks, Pizzas, Sides] (confirmed also by the admin menu editor, which still lists DRINKS, PIZZAS, SIDES), so pulling Pizzas to the front while keeping the others' relative order should yield [Pizzas, Drinks, Sides]. The rendered home page instead shows [Pizzas, Sides, Drinks] -- Drinks and Sides are swapped relative to their original order. Criterion 2 fails.
evidence: Rendered / page text order: Pizzas, Sides, Drinks
/manage/menu admin list groups in alphabetical DRINKS, PIZZAS, SIDES order

stories.message: 'We deliver within 3 miles' appears directly under the shop name heading on the home page (/). But the shop name 'Harbor Street Pizza' is also shown as the top nav brand on every other customer page (e.g. /basket, /checkout) and the delivery line does not appear there, so it does not hold 'wherever the shop name is shown to customers' as written.
evidence: GET /preview/ text: 'Harbor Street Pizza' ... 'We deliver within 3 miles'
GET /preview/basket text: 'Harbor Street Pizza' nav brand, no delivery line
GET /preview/checkout text: 'Harbor Street Pizza' nav brand, no delivery line

stories.message: Signed in as admin (password). On /manage/menu, Add item: filled Name, Price and Category (Description could not be reliably isolated by selector during this automated walk; it is optional per the form's own help text so this does not block the story). POST /preview/MenuAdminApi returned 201. The new item ('QA Second Item', Sides, £6.25) appeared in the admin list with no error banner, and GET /preview/MenuApi (the public menu) included it immediately with no separate 'mark available' step needed.
evidence: GET /preview/MenuApi includes {id:9c15bc3a-9e75-46e4-ad02-8bb5f2a02871, name:'QA Second Item', priceCents:625, category:'Sides'}
admin list shows the new row under SIDES with no error banner

stories.message: Signed in as admin (password). On /manage/menu, Edit on item 'ProbeC', changed price from £1.00 to £3.33, Save. POST /preview/MenuAdminApi/update returned 200 and the list immediately showed £3.33 with no error banner. This contradicts the previously-recorded gotcha of 400s on MenuAdminApi writes -- the update path works in this build.
evidence: admin list shows 'ProbeC ... £3.33' immediately after save, no error banner

notes: Tested on https://harbor-street-pizza.immensus-staging.app/preview/. authScope is left to the platform's own two-account measurement as instructed. rollbackReady was not exercised (no rollback action was part of any story or available to a QA session). Anonymous probes to MenuAdminApi, OrderAdminApi and StoreSettingsApi all returned 403 {code:'auth_required'} with no WWW-Authenticate header. A member account (member-one@example.com, signed in via link) hitting /manage, /manage/menu, /manage/orders was safely shown the public customer shell (no admin content, no error), and hitting MenuAdminApi/OrderAdminApi/StoreSettingsApi directly got 403 {code:'admin_required'} with no browser dialog. member2's sign-in attempt hit a 'BrowserKilled' (memory cap) environment error and was not retried since roleEscalation was already demonstrated with member. During menu-item editing, several extra test/probe items were created on this shop's live menu while diagnosing a CSS-selector issue in the Add/Edit item dialog (names: 'QA test description', 'QA Second Item', 'ProbeName', 'ProbeC' at £3.33, 'ProbeD2'); none were cleaned up because no reliable selector for the Delete action on a specific row was found during this walk -- the founder may want to remove these from the live menu.
